text: Under the purview of the Dean of Students, the Office of Community Standards and Conduct investigates allegations of academic dishonesty. As a member of the UT Dallas community, faculty and staff may be the first ones to notice a student exhibiting distress, disruptive behavior or academic dishonesty. The student does not need to be violating any University rules or regulations for you to be concerned. Please contact the Office of Community Standards and Conduct and we can begin a dialogue with the student and provide referrals. Allegations of student conduct violations are to be referred to the Dean of Students.
source_title: Community Standards and Conduct: Faculty and Staff

text: The Behavior Assessment and Intervention Team (BAIT) reviews behavioral incidents and ensures a systematic response to students whose behavior may be disruptive or harmful to themselves or the UT Dallas community, and assists in promoting the health, safety and welfare of students and other members of the UT Dallas community. Faculty and staff can submit the following referrals to the Office of Community Standards and Conduct: an Academic Dishonesty Referral; a Discipline Referral; and a Student Concerns (BAIT) Referral. Related guidance pages for faculty and staff cover Managing Difficult Student Behavior, Preventing Academic Dishonesty, and Detecting Acts of Academic Dishonesty.
source_title: Community Standards and Conduct: Faculty and Staff
